# Module: `icescopy_temperature_import`

Parse temperature files and resolve timestamps and cooling cycles.

[Source](../src/icescopy_temperature_import.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Independent parsers cover standard CSV, UTK CSV, CSU `.dat`, TAMU Linkam `.xlsx`, and PKU Linksys32 `.iml`, with calibration and timestamp helpers. Result dataclasses carry parsed times and values; the freeze-count mixin joins them to cell events. Format-specific validation raises `TemperatureImportError`.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`TemperatureImportError`](API-Class-TemperatureImportError.md) | Reports a temperature-file or timestamp validation failure. |
| [`CSUISDatRow`](API-Class-CSUISDatRow.md) | One parsed CSU row, including recorded timing and cumulative sample counts. |
| [`TAMULinkamTimeseries`](API-Class-TAMULinkamTimeseries.md) | Parsed TAMU relative temperature times, temperatures, and an optional start timestamp. |
| [`Linksys32IMLImageRecord`](API-Class-Linksys32IMLImageRecord.md) | One Linksys32 image record with image number, timestamp, and temperature. |
| [`Linksys32IMLTimeseries`](API-Class-Linksys32IMLTimeseries.md) | Parsed Linksys32 temperature samples plus image-record associations. |
| [`StandardTemperatureTimeseries`](API-Class-StandardTemperatureTimeseries.md) | Parsed timestamp and temperature arrays for the standard CSV path. |
| [`ResolvedImageTimestamps`](API-Class-ResolvedImageTimestamps.md) | Resolved image times, a successful-parse count, and names that could not be parsed. |
